```{r}
#| label: setup
# Display only: all data work happens in R/prep_data.R.
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(bslib)
library(bsicons)
library(htmltools)

d    <- readRDS("data/dashboard_data.rds")
meta <- d$meta
fy   <- paste0("FY", substr(meta$fy, 3, 4))
fy_period <- paste0("October ", meta$fy - 1, " - September ", meta$fy)

# ---- Shared styling (one place to change colors and sizes) ----
col_male   <- "#2a78d6"
col_female <- "#eb6834"
col_status <- c("90% and above" = "#0a7d0a",
                "75-89%"        = "#6cc46c",
                "50-74%"        = "#fab219",
                "Below 50%"     = "#d03b3b")
ink        <- "#0b0b0b"
ink_muted  <- "#52514e"
grid_col   <- "#e8e8e5"
goal       <- 0.95                               # 95-95-95 goal line

tv_layout <- function(p, ...) {
  p |>
    layout(font = list(size = 16, color = ink),
           paper_bgcolor = "white", plot_bgcolor = "white",
           margin = list(l = 10, r = 30, t = 10, b = 10),
           hoverlabel = list(font = list(size = 16)), ...) |>
    config(displayModeBar = FALSE, responsive = TRUE)
}

pct <- scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1, big.mark = ",")
num <- scales::label_comma()

result_of <- function(code) {
  v <- d$performance$result[d$performance$mer == code]
  if (length(v)) v else NA_real_
}
hts_tst <- result_of("HTS_TST")
hts_pos <- result_of("HTS_TST_POS")
tx_new  <- result_of("TX_NEW")
cas     <- d$cascade

# Same look as the current dashboard's boxes
box <- function(title, value, icon, bg) {
  value_box(
    title    = tags$span(title, class = "vb-title"),
    value    = value,
    showcase = bs_icon(icon),
    theme    = value_box_theme(bg = bg, fg = "white")
  )
}
```

# Program Performance `r fy`

## Row

```{r}
#| title: !expr paste("PROGRAM AREA PERFORMANCE AGAINST TARGETS |", toupper(fy_period))
#| width: 55%
perf <- d$performance |>
  filter(!is.na(target), target > 0) |>
  mutate(mer    = factor(mer, levels = rev(mer)),
         status = factor(status, levels = names(col_status)),
         shown  = pmin(achievement, 1.5),   # cap the bar so one outlier can't squash the rest
         label  = paste0(pct(achievement), "  ", num(result), " / ", num(target)))

plot_ly(perf, y = ~mer, x = ~shown, type = "bar", orientation = "h",
        color = ~status, colors = col_status,
        text = ~label, textposition = "outside", cliponaxis = FALSE,
        textfont = list(color = ink, size = 15),
        customdata = ~source,
        hovertemplate = "%{y}: %{text}<br>Source: %{customdata}<extra></extra>") |>
  tv_layout(xaxis = list(title = "", tickformat = ".0%", range = c(0, 1.95),
                         gridcolor = grid_col, tickvals = seq(0, 1.5, 0.25)),
            yaxis = list(title = ""), bargap = 0.3,
            legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = 1.05,
                          title = list(text = "Achievement  ")),
            shapes = list(list(type = "line", x0 = 1, x1 = 1, y0 = 0, y1 = 1,
                               yref = "paper",
                               line = list(color = ink, width = 2, dash = "dot"))))
```

```{r}
#| title: VIRAL LOAD COVERAGE BY AGE AND SEX (GOAL 95%)
#| width: 45%
vas  <- d$vl_age_sex
ages <- levels(vas$age_band)

plot_ly() |>
  add_markers(data = filter(vas, sex == "Male"), x = ~vl_coverage, y = ~age_band,
              name = "Male", marker = list(color = col_male, size = 16, symbol = "circle"),
              text = ~paste0(num(vl_current), " of ", num(vl_eligible), " eligible"),
              hovertemplate = "Male %{y}: %{x:.0%}<br>%{text}<extra></extra>") |>
  add_markers(data = filter(vas, sex == "Female"), x = ~vl_coverage, y = ~age_band,
              name = "Female", marker = list(color = col_female, size = 16, symbol = "diamond"),
              text = ~paste0(num(vl_current), " of ", num(vl_eligible), " eligible"),
              hovertemplate = "Female %{y}: %{x:.0%}<br>%{text}<extra></extra>") |>
  tv_layout(xaxis = list(title = "", tickformat = ".0%", range = c(0, 1.02),
                         gridcolor = grid_col),
            yaxis = list(title = "", categoryorder = "array", categoryarray = ages),
            legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = 1.06),
            shapes = list(list(type = "line", x0 = goal, x1 = goal, y0 = 0, y1 = 1,
                               yref = "paper",
                               line = list(dash = "dot", color = ink_muted, width = 2))))
```

# Monthly Trends `r fy`

```{r}
#| title: !expr paste("MONTHLY RESULTS |", toupper(fy_period))
key <- c(HTS_TST_POS = "New positives", TX_NEW = "New on ART",
         TX_CURR = "Current on ART", TX_PVLS_D = "Had a VL result")

panels <- lapply(names(key), function(code) {
  plot_ly(filter(d$trend, mer == code), x = ~period, y = ~value,
          type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
          line = list(color = col_male, width = 2),
          marker = list(size = 8, color = col_male),
          hovertemplate = paste0(key[[code]], " %{x|%b %Y}: %{y:,}<extra></extra>"),
          showlegend = FALSE)
})
titles <- lapply(seq_along(key), function(i) {
  list(text = paste0("<b>", key[[i]], "</b>"), showarrow = FALSE,
       xref = paste0("x", if (i > 1) i, " domain"),
       yref = paste0("y", if (i > 1) i, " domain"),
       x = 0, y = 1, yanchor = "bottom", xanchor = "left", font = list(size = 16))
})
axis_y <- list(rangemode = "tozero", gridcolor = grid_col)
axis_x <- list(tickformat = "%b", dtick = "M1", gridcolor = grid_col)
subplot(panels, nrows = 2, margin = c(0.04, 0.04, 0.08, 0.08)) |>
  tv_layout(annotations = titles) |>
  layout(margin = list(t = 40, l = 10, r = 10, b = 10),
         xaxis = axis_x, xaxis2 = axis_x, xaxis3 = axis_x, xaxis4 = axis_x,
         yaxis = axis_y, yaxis2 = axis_y, yaxis3 = axis_y, yaxis4 = axis_y)
```

```{r}
#| title: VL COVERAGE AND SUPPRESSION BY SITE (RANKED BY COVERAGE)
cs <- d$cascade_site |> arrange(vl_coverage) |>
  mutate(site = factor(site, levels = site))

plot_ly(cs, y = ~site) |>
  add_segments(x = ~vl_coverage, xend = ~vl_suppression, yend = ~site,
               line = list(color = "#cfcfca", width = 3),
               hoverinfo = "skip", showlegend = FALSE) |>
  add_markers(x = ~vl_coverage, name = "Coverage",
              marker = list(color = col_male, size = 12),
              text = ~paste0(num(vl_current), " of ", num(vl_eligible), " eligible"),
              hovertemplate = "%{y} coverage: %{x:.0%}<br>%{text}<extra></extra>") |>
  add_markers(x = ~vl_suppression, name = "Suppression",
              marker = list(color = col_female, size = 12, symbol = "diamond"),
              text = ~paste0(num(supp_1000), " of ", num(vl_current), " results"),
              hovertemplate = "%{y} suppression: %{x:.0%}<br>%{text}<extra></extra>") |>
  tv_layout(xaxis = list(title = "", tickformat = ".0%", range = c(0, 1.02),
                         gridcolor = grid_col),
            yaxis = list(title = "", tickfont = list(size = 14),
                         tickmode = "array", tickvals = levels(cs$site)),
            legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = 1.02, yanchor = "bottom"),
            margin = list(t = 40, l = 10, r = 30, b = 10),
            shapes = list(list(type = "line", x0 = goal, x1 = goal, y0 = 0, y1 = 1,
                               yref = "paper",
                               line = list(dash = "dot", color = ink_muted, width = 2))))
```

```{r}
#| title: VIRAL LOAD RESULTS BY SITE (C/ML)
bands <- c("<50" = "#0a7d0a", "50-199" = "#fab219", "200-999" = "#ec835a", "1000+" = "#d03b3b")
vb <- d$vl_bands_site |>
  mutate(share = n / sum(n), .by = site) |>
  mutate(vl_band = factor(vl_band, levels = names(bands)))
site_order <- vb |> filter(vl_band == "<50") |> arrange(share) |> pull(site)

plot_ly(vb, y = ~site, x = ~share, color = ~vl_band, colors = bands,
        type = "bar", orientation = "h",
        text = ~paste0(num(n), " results"), textposition = "none",
        hovertemplate = "%{y} | %{fullData.name}: %{x:.0%} (%{text})<extra></extra>",
        marker = list(line = list(color = "white", width = 1))) |>
  tv_layout(barmode = "stack",
            yaxis = list(title = "", categoryorder = "array", categoryarray = site_order,
                         tickmode = "array", tickvals = site_order,
                         tickfont = list(size = 14)),
            xaxis = list(title = "", tickformat = ".0%", gridcolor = grid_col),
            legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = 1.02, yanchor = "bottom",
                          traceorder = "normal"),
            margin = list(t = 40, l = 10, r = 30, b = 10))
```
